title: Liquids Sort Puzzle
description:
Colorful, bubbling, fragrant, and iridescent concoctions fill flasks, jugs, and test tubes in varying proportions!

Figure out strategy and create harmony by collecting liquids of different colors and properties in different containers!

Test your attention and reasoning skills in this meditative puzzle game. 

Many levels of increasing difficulty and bonus tasks await you! 

Excellent attention training and good mood guaranteed!

title: Paint Sponges Puzzle
description: Challenge your logic and strategy in this exciting puzzle game! Swipe to move the sponge and color every square in the maze with vibrant colors. It might seem straightforward, but don’t be fooled! Each level brings more complex mazes to test your problem-solving skills. Plan carefully, avoid traps, and complete all levels. Sharpen your mind and enjoy victories in this colorful adventure!

title: Thread Match
description: Immerse yourself in the world of Thread Match — a unique and exciting puzzle where you sort colorful threads to complete embroidery patterns. Unravel layers of palettes, carefully working your way down to reveal hidden threads. Use logic and strategy to avoid running out of moves. But be careful — the color palette can be tricky, and every choice matters!

title: Hit ball
description:
Hit ball is a fast-paced arcade game with roguelike elements, in which you fight off waves of enemies with ricocheting balls! With each shot you break through obstacles, knock down monsters and earn experience to improve your abilities.
Dozens of levels with unique traps, walls, boosting balls and dangerous bosses await you. Collect boosters, pick up abilities, regenerate health and strategize to survive the battle!

title: Scary Teacher 3D Returns
description:
Start with the size of a board. A faint sound echoes through the hallway. You freeze, the heart is beating, and the house seems to breathe with you. You are inside the mansion of the old teacher once again.

In the 3D fear teacher, every shadow, every echo matters. Your goal is not to escape; it is mischief. But make an error, and you will become its next goal.

title: Cupid’s Story: Love Archer Bow
description: In Cupid's Story: Love Archer Bow, you play as a love archer armed with a trusty bow. Your mission is to shoot love arrows that connect hearts and spark romance. Aim carefully and watch as sparks fly and love blooms in the most unexpected places. Mix and match hearts to create unique and charming couples, from quirky characters to unlikely pairings. The possibilities are endless in this one-of-a-kind game.

title: Crush the Eggs
description: In this game, eggs have appeared that you will have to fight with and break. In front of you on the screen you will see a platform on which the egg will be located. Above it you will see a special field. Using the mouse you can draw any object on it. When you finish your actions, this item will fall directly onto the egg. If your calculations are correct, then you will break it and thus destroy it. After this you will move to the next level of the game.

title: Pixel Journey
description: The “Pixel Journey” will appeal to all fans of exploration, collecting resources in a cozy pixel world. It combines a cozy atmosphere and addictive gameplay. Reach the end and find out all the secrets! Support us by leaving a review and comment! If you have any comments or suggestions, please describe them and we will try to make improvements quickly!

title: Bloons Survival.io
description:
Bloons Survival. io is a fast-paced survival arcade game where you fight off endless waves of balloons!

Control your monkey hero, throw darts automatically, and pop incoming enemies before they get too close.
Collect coins and power-ups to grow stronger, but stay alert — one hit can end your run!

How long can you survive?

title: Dogs vs Aliens
description: Your favorite pets have been kidnapped by evil aliens! Hurry to save them and punish the alien bullies. Evolve to defeat stronger enemies, free new dogs, get unique resources so that your dogs can evolve! Collect all the dog breeds and see how cool they will be! Discover new territories, visit the beach, park, city square and forest!

title: Mahjong Crimes - Puzzle Story
description:
MYSTERIOUS FEATURES

Play 100+ Mahjong exciting levels! 
Dive into Agatha Christie's stories 
Use boosters and collect tile sets

PLAY MAHJONG

Mahjong Crimes is a puzzle game where you match tiles to find clues and solve crimes. Use power-ups to beat tricky levels and win awards!

SOLVE CRIMES

Join detective Hercule Poirot on the Orient Express to solve crimes in this Mahjong game! Match tiles to investigate, defeat thugs, and untangle mysteries. Fun guaranteed!

title: Army Commander Craft
description:
Welcome to Army Commander Craft, a game full of strategy and shooting elements. As a commander, building and upgrading your army. Lead them into nervous battles against enemy forces.Command your army to begin nervous shooting battles. Defeat the enemy units with precision
and strategy.

title: Tarcat
description:
Enter the world of feline destruction with Tarcat, a hilarious casual game where you control a cats paw! Your goal? Smash all targets with quick reflexes and pinpoint accuracy!

With just one tap, hit targets, avoid traps, and dominate each level with the style of a true feline destroyer.

title: Cougar Simulator: Big Cats
description: Experience life as a powerful cougar in a vast open world! Customize your big cat’s appearance, find a mate, and raise a family that aids in hunting and battles. Level up your skills, complete quests, and compete against other felines. Explore diverse environments filled with various animals, from farm creatures to fierce predators. Hunt, survive, and prove your strength in this immersive wild adventure!

title: Pato Vs Cops
description: lay Pato Vs Cops — the ultimate free browser police chase game! No download needed — jump into nonstop car chases, dodge roadblocks, and outdrive relentless cops in fast-paced arcade action. Perfect for fans of unblocked racing games, endless car chase games, and online driving challenges. Show off your reflexes, collect power-ups, and see how long you can survive the heat in this thrilling high-speed pursuit!

title: Word Game 2026
description: Immerse yourself in "Word Puzzle," a premium brain-teasing game featuring a stunning 3D animated background! Test your vocabulary and fast-thinking skills by guessing the missing letters before the thrilling 30-second timer runs out. With 100 exciting levels, neon-glassmorphism graphics, and highly addictive gameplay, this game will keep you hooked for hours. Can you become the ultimate Word Master?

title: Kitty Match 3 puzzle game
description:
Kitty Match is a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game with adorable cats. Match tiles, create combos, and clear levels in a relaxing and colorful world.

Easy to play and perfect for all ages. Enjoy smooth gameplay and endless puzzle fun.

Start your cute cat adventure now!

title: Stickman Adventure
description: This is an adventure that will take you through time and space! Along the way, you'll encounter various traps and monsters; you'll need to defeat them and rescue your friends. Come on, Hero, a whole new world awaits!

title: Gun Match Screw
description: a unique level-based puzzle game that combines screw puzzles with exciting gun-themed mechanics. In this game, each level presents you with a board shaped like different guns or gun parts, and your goal is to unlock all the boards by matching colored screws, which are represented as bullets.

title: Find 6 Differences – Spot the Hidden Changes!
description: Put your observation skills to the test in Find 6 Differences, a fun and relaxing puzzle game! With 20 unique levels, each featuring two nearly identical images, your goal is simple: find the 6 differences before time runs out! 20 challenging levels with beautifully designed images and engaging gameplay that sharpens your attention to detail. Hint system to help you when you're stuck.

title: Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game
description: Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game lets you build your perfect movie theater and run a profitable business. Choose the best films to satisfy guests and increase income. Expand parking, open snack kiosks, automate processes, and hire employees to optimize operations. Complete over 50 missions, enjoy colorful 3D graphics, and immerse yourself in a unique atmosphere. Buy movies, prepare snacks, and grow your theater to attract more viewers. Ready to become the top drive-in owner?

title: Apocalypse Shelter
description: The world has fallen — but survival is still possible. Build and expand your shelter, manage resources, and create a safe haven in a hostile environment. Assemble a squad of unique heroes, each with their own abilities and combat style. Engage in tactical turn-based battles, plan your moves, and use your team’s skills to overcome dangerous enemies. Unlock new characters from chests, upgrade their cards, and build the ultimate squad to survive the apocalypse.

title: Word Stars
description: Find hidden words and piece together your success. Each puzzle is a step towards mastering the game and expanding your word power. Use hints to keep progressing. From the first word to the last, it’s a race to finish all the levels.

title: Pixel Shoot
description: Pixel Shoot is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game. It's simple to play by just tapping the cannons. Make sure you pay attention to the color and base your strategy around it. You must also manage your capacity, and timing is key! Send your cannons in the right order, manage the flow, and maximize your score.

title: Office Pyramid Solitaire
description: Your objective in Office Pyramid Solitaire is to clear the card pyramid. On hard difficulty you must also clear the draw deck.

title: Color Dodge
description:
Color Dodge is a fast-paced, addictive color-matching arcade game where reflexes and precision are your only hope!

Control a glowing circle and survive as colorful walls charge toward you from all directions. Here's the twist — you must collide only with the wall segment that matches your color, or you explode in a juicy blast!

Whether you're chasing high scores or just vibing with neon chaos, Color Dodge delivers bite-sized action with a splash of style.

title: Manyunya Saving the Princess
description: Welcome to the time when there were knights, magic, farmers, princesses, and generals. Manyunya sets off at the request of the Supreme Lord to save his princess. On the way you will find a whole dangerous adventure, you will come across colorful views, and characters with whom you can communicate and interact, as well as enemies that you will need to defeat at any cost, and save the princess, and complete the task. Interesting voice acting and story will immerse you in this world with your head!

title: Catch Thief
description: Catch Thief is an addictive puzzle game where you must outsmart a clever thief and stop his escape. Take control of the police, block every possible path and drive the criminal into a dead end. With each new level the challenge grows, requiring you to plan ahead, think strategically and act quickly. Bright cartoon graphics, fun scenarios and increasing difficulty make Catch Thief a perfect choice for fans of logic games who enjoy testing their skills, attention and reaction speed.

title: Safe Merge
description: A simple idle merge game, you need to merge safes with same design to make a safe more powerfull, you need to unlock all design to win the game, the design are in the right, if the game was hard you can do prestige to win more money per cicle.

title: Dark Myth: Monkey Merge
description: Merge warriors, build your army, and fight through hordes of monsters as the Monkey King! Your master and companions have been captured — combine strategy and action to rescue them all. From Common to Legendary, every merge makes you stronger.

title: Find It Fast
description: Discover the ultimate hidden object game! Test your observation skills by uncovering hidden items in fun, challenging levels. Relax and enjoy this scavenger hunt adventure with stunning puzzles. Focus on listed items, tap to reveal hidden objects, and race against time to unlock vibrant maps. Explore interactive scenes, solve puzzles, and prove yourself as the scavenger hunt master! Enjoy free gameplay, endless entertainment, and thrilling challenges. Play now and see what you can FIND!

title: Wool Sorting
description:
Wool Sorting is a super relaxing and addictive yarn-connecting puzzle game!
In LEVEL 2, slide and merge colorful wool segments to create perfect complete threads. Match colors and sequences with precision — simple to play, yet deeply satisfying!
Challenge yourself across LV.10, 15 & 20. Soothing, brain-teasing fun for any moment!

title: Dream Kitchen
description: Dream Kitchen is a fun and fast-paced restaurant simulation game inspired by shawarma-style cooking gameplay. Take customer orders, cook the right food, and serve every dish on time to keep customers happy. Complete levels with 3-star ratings, earn coins, upgrade your kitchen equipment, and unlock new recipes. Explore multiple themed chapters, including a Pancake Shop, Street Stall, Fast Food Restaurant, and Western Restaurant, each with unique dishes and challenges!

title: DuaLight - A Reflected Game
description:
DuaLight is a challenging 2D pixel art hyper-casual platformer. The true path lies in the reflection. 

Navigate levels where the real world tricks your eyes, and only those who watch the reflection below can move forward. Minimalist and short.

In DuaLight – A Reflected Game, nothing is as it seems… or rather, everything only appears in the reflection. You control a character in a world where invisible platforms can’t be seen in the real world, but only in the reflection below the screen.

title: BOMBAMAN 3D
description: Blast your way through a thrilling 3D adventure! Use bombs to destroy obstacles, defeat monsters, and uncover power-ups. Find the hidden gate before time runs out, battle bosses, and unlock upgrades. Play solo or with a friend for nonstop action-packed fun!

title: STELLAR GUARDIAN
description: Stellar Guardian – Cosmic Defense Force is a fast-paced space shooter where you command powerful ships, unlock upgrades, and defend the galaxy across challenging missions and game modes. to fix the lag you need to keep the PC on a full screen, while on other devices it runs smoothly

title: Pool Duel
description: Keep your focus sharp as the clock ticks down, knowing that timing and precision will lead you to victory. Master your aim and cue control, because flawless execution and smart strategy separate true champions from the rest in every challenging match.

title: Block Escape
description: Block Escape is a brain-teasing puzzle game where players clear blocks by moving them off the screen in the direction shown by the arrows on each block. Each level requires logical thinking and careful planning, as blocks can only move in specific directions, making every puzzle increasingly challenging and strategic.

title: Sniper Wars: Find the Criminal
description: The snipers have begun the battle! Find the villain among the crowd of citizens and eliminate him. Take a rifle and go on a dangerous mission to find the criminal! You have a photo of the criminal and a rifle, find him and eliminate him!

title: Isometric Escape 2
description: Isometric Escape 2 challenges you to solve a variety of puzzles in uniquely designed isometric rooms. Search for hidden objects and use your logic and memory to unravel the riddles and escape.

title: Purrfect Bakery
description: Purrfect Bakery is a cozy and heartwarming game where a sweet cat runs a bakery for cute animal customers. Serve yummy treats, unlock new adorable visitors, and enjoy the simple joy of baking and friendship!

title: Mosquito Bite 3d
description: Play the role of a buzzing mosquito and start a fun simulator. Flying through various environments to find your target and attack her. Your goal is to find the best moment to sneak up on your target and bite her. Your tasks such as attacking a human's head or legs. But be careful, your target might swat at you at any time.

title: Springle Puzzle
description: Springle Puzzle is a fun and fast jigsaw game where you solve puzzles before time runs out. Choose from styles like Classic, Irregular, Hexagon, or Wave, each with a different feel. Play easy mode with fewer pieces for a quick game and lower score, or pick more pieces for a harder challenge and higher score. If time runs out, watch a reward ad and keep playing.

title: Color Conquest: Territory War
description:
Command one of 4 unique factions in this intense RTS war! Capture territories to expand your army and destroy enemy bases.

Factions:

Grey: High HP (Tank), slow production.

Green: Fast spawn (Swarm), low HP.

Blue & Yellow: Balanced fighters.

Capture neutral zones to increase your unit capacity. Can you dominate the map?

title: Grow a Garden 3D
description:
Welcome to Grow a Garden, a fun and peaceful game where you plant seeds and grow magical trees! ?
Explore different seasons, customize your character, and watch your garden grow bigger every day.
Every seed is special and every garden is unique!

title: Black Pink St.Patricks day Concert
description: Step into the glamorous world of Black Pink St. Patrick’s Day Concert, the ultimate dress-up game! Style your favorite Black Pink members with trendy outfits, accessories, and makeup to make them shine for their St. Patrick’s Day performance. With simple controls and endless creativity, this game is perfect for quick fun or long gaming sessions.

title: Goal Rush
description:
Goal Rush is a fast-paced neon football showdown where precision and quick reflexes lead to victory! Play solo against a challenging AI or compete in thrilling 1v1 battles with a friend.

With dynamic arenas, tricky obstacles, and intense goal-scoring action, every match feels fresh and exciting. Outsmart your opponent, master the controls, and dominate the field in this minimal yet action-packed football experience!

Are you ready to take on the challenge and score the ultimate goal?

title: Candy Jewels
description: It is a candy-filled puzzle adventure full of surprises! Match candies, break chests and collect coins as you progress through countless levels. Complete fun events like Time Attack or Coin Catch and use boosters to overcome tricky obstacles even faster!

title: Bingo Halloween
description: A Halloween-themed bingo game where you can win exciting bingos to unlock spooky candy-themed images. Enjoy multiple call speeds and progressive unlocks.

title: Chain Puzzle
description: Chain Puzzle is a relaxing logic game where you carefully untangle intricate chained constructions. Each construction is a single system of two same-colored balls connected by a chain. Every move changes the shape of the structure: the chain can automatically shorten, opening new ways to solve the puzzle. Observe, adjust positions, and find the right sequence of actions to completely unravel the knot.

title: Childcare Master Online
description: Get ready to become a parenting superstar in Childcare Master Online! This wonderful casual simulation game is all about playing the role of a top parenting expert. As soon as you start the game, you'll find yourself in a lively daycare center with adorable kids. What's your mission? Give them love and care! First, you need to create a warm environment.

title: Artillery Vs Tanks
description: In this game, you take control of an artillery unit and engage in combat against enemy tanks. The result of the battle hinges on how precisely you target your shots – will you obliterate all the tanks before they reach you, or will they overpower you? Take out your foes and collect rewards to enhance your howitzer's performance and acquire fresh, more formidable artillery weapons!

title: Kids Supermarket
description: Welcome to Kids Supermarket, a casual supermarket simulation game for kids. Have you ever gone shopping alone? Feel confused about finding goods among a large number of products? Join Kids Supermarket to elevate your observation and categorization skills. Our diverse and clearly aligned products will make you feel like shopping in a real-life supermarket. Pick up your shopping basket and start your journey in the supermarket.

title: Fish Out of Water!
description:
Dive into a thrilling adventure with Fish Out of Water, without ads or in-app purchases. A captivating game by Halfbrick Studios, the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride. Launch a group of brave fish pals into the sky and over the ocean, helping them travel far and bounce as much as possible!

Experience remastered graphics and audio and enjoy a rebalanced crystal unlocking system for a more rewarding experience.

title: Word Rush
description: Word Rush combines solitaire mechanics with word puzzles for a unique and addictive experience! Clear lettered cards by forming words, drawing new cards from the deck to create high-scoring combinations. Each move opens up fresh opportunities, keeping the game exciting and dynamic. With endless word possibilities, Word Rush offers fun for everyone, from casual players to word puzzle enthusiasts. Challenge your vocabulary and strategy skills in this thrilling game!

title: Chicken Math
description: I am Archimedes. I've been trying to solve this difficult problem for a week, and those chickens have stolen my numbers again. Grab the rifle and head to the backyard. Find and retrieve my numbers. Just be careful — I need the correct numbers!

title: Merge Brainrot 2
description:
Drop and merge the new  Italian Brainrot memes!
From "Bobrito Bandito" to "Špijuniro Golubiro" and "Burbaloni Lulilolli", they’re all here.
What final Brainrot will you unlock? Dare to find out!

title: Travel Mahjong Deluxe
description: Travel Mahjong Deluxe is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle where you match identical tiles and strategically clear the board. Find pairs of beautiful travel-themed tiles that are free on at least one side and remove them to complete each level. As you progress, new layouts and challenges will keep the game fresh and engaging. Use the Hint feature whenever you get stuck, or watch a reward video to gain unlimited time and continue your puzzle-solving adventure.

title: GT Flying Car Racing
description: GT Flying Car Racing is an exhilarating game where players race high-speed GT cars that can transform into flying machines! Navigate through challenging tracks, perform daring aerial maneuvers, and switch seamlessly between driving and flying modes. Avoid obstacles, compete against rivals, and master both land and air racing to become the ultimate champion!

title: Ping Pong Air
description: Table tennis, also known as ping pong, is an easy and enjoyable arcade game in which you control the bat as simply as in life: with the mouse or the movement of your finger. Several modes await you to suit every taste. In classic mode, you go through worlds, earn cups and unlock new opportunities. In Halloween mode, you have to banish spirits for a while, improving your reaction. In Career mode, you move up the tournament ladder, taking part in games against increasingly stronger opponents.

title: The Superhero League
description: Want to join the Superhero League and unlock endless puzzle fun? In The Superhero League, you’ll become a superhero and begin an exciting puzzle adventure. Take on various killing missions, solve puzzles, and save the world. Control your hero through challenging levels and become the strongest hero of all! This creative puzzle game combines superhero elements with rich strategy gameplay.

title: Live Star Doll Dress Up
description: Discover the makeover world of fashion and fun in Live Star Doll Dress Up Games! Immerse yourself in an interactive magic princess universe! In this dress-up anime simulator, you're in charge. Dress up your doll in trendy outfits. Get creative with makeup and personalize your cute doll!

title: Hidden Object Adventure
description: Are you ready to solve puzzles and uncover hidden secrets? Become a detective in Find Hidden Object Game and test your observation skills! Explore detailed scenes in schools, houses, amusement parks, and zoos. Search for cleverly hidden items, challenge your brain, and enjoy fun, relaxing gameplay. Perfect for casual players and puzzle lovers alike. Train your mind and become the ultimate detective!

title: Hard Puzzle
description:
Enter a vibrant, calming world of geometry where your goal is to build perfect squares from colorful pieces. Fit the shapes together, unlock new levels, and challenge your logic and spatial skills. Need help? Use a hint to keep going!
? Easy to play, hard to master
? Relaxing visuals
? A quick, fun brain boost anytime
Start puzzling and become a geometry master!

title: Sort Game Toy Sort
description: Enjoy some adorable sorting fun in Sort Game: Toy Sort. This delightful match 3 puzzle and casual sort game challenges you to organize colorful dolls and toys. Match and eliminate all dolls within the limited time. When you encounter difficulties, use items to help you quickly clear the level. Such as Convert, Eliminate, Refresh or Break.

title: Color It in 3D
description:
Meet the best 3D coloring book!
Relax, immerse yourself in creativity and get inspired!
Draw and create fantasy, cartoon, funny and anime action figures!
If you like 3D character designs, drawing, coloring, then this coloring book is for you.

title: CloneUp - Stack Yourself
description:
CloneUp – Stack Yourself is a 2D pixel-art platformer where your greatest tool is… yourself!

Create clones, stack them, and use them as platforms to dodge spikes, reach new heights, and make your way to the exit door.

In CloneUp – Stack Yourself, you’ll use copies of the main character to reach platforms and avoid deadly obstacles.

title: Offroad Jeep Game Simulator
description: Off road legends are brought to you by offline Car Games or Car Racing Games no wifi Tap studios that open an exciting (4x4 mania or 4x4 off road games) 4x4 Off road SUV Jeep Driving Games where off road outlaws or off road jeep drivers will take SUV test drive ahead in Hill Jeep Driving Simulator and Monster Truck Games. Extreme car driving simulator game.

title: Puzzle Lab
description: Tap connected blocks to clear them! If any blocks are left, you will lose life. The game ends when your life reaches 0. You can use placed special bombs by tapping them.

title: Axe Throw
description:
Ready to test your precision? Welcome to Axe Throw, the ultimate test of aim and timing. The rules are simple, but the challenge is endless. You have one goal: Break the target.

But be careful—the path to victory is rigged with danger. Explosive bombs are moving, and blocking your way. One wrong move, and it's game over!

title: Panda Lu Treehouse
description: Hey, animal lovers! Enter the enchanting world of Panda Lu's Tree House, a super fun casual simulator that will warm your heart. In this game, you play as the caretaker of the adorable panda Lu. Your adventure begins by building a magnificent tree house, a cozy and vibrant home for your furry friend.

title: Coe Snake
description: Coe Snake brings the classic snake game with new challenges! Collect fruits, dodge meteors, walls, bombs, and balls that move like ping pong. Multiple modes, scenarios, and fruits to choose from. Fast-paced, colorful, and addictive — how far can you go?

title: Sudoku Master
description: Sudoku by in8finity is a classic puzzle game with a sleek dark theme, offering a smooth and enjoyable experience. Flexible settings let you adjust the difficulty to match your skill level. With intuitive controls and eye-friendly visuals, you can focus on solving puzzles without distractions. More than just a game, Sudoku trains logic, concentration, and memory. Challenge yourself and enjoy relaxing, distraction-free gameplay!

title: Sudoku Vault
description: Sudoku Vault is a logic-based puzzle game featuring 4x4, 6x6, and 9x9 boards — each with four difficulty levels: Basic, Normal, Hard, and Expert. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, every grid offers a fresh challenge for your mind. Use smart NOTES to keep track of possibilities, and when you want to check your progress, tap the CHECK button — it will remove incorrect inputs and lock the correct ones, helping you stay focused on the solution.

title: Dig out of Prison
description:
You are a prisoner determined to break free. Dig tunnels with a spoon, shovel, or anything you can find. Discover valuables, trade with fellow inmates and even the guards, and earn the prison’s top currency — toilet paper.

Upgrade your digging and trading skills, unlock better tools, and speed up your escape. But be careful — plan your moves and avoid drawing attention, because freedom is the prize only for the most cunning.

title: Teacher Simulator
description: Teacher Simulator is a fun simulation game in which you play the role of a teacher. Mark exams and ensure the kids are on their best behavior. You may have been the student, but now you get to be the one in charge!

title: Student and Teacher
description:
The school is not ready for you!
Broken laptops, chairs in splinters, the dining room is looted!
Revenge is a dish served in the form of chaos!
Forget about the silent protest – only crushing anarchy!
Make your classmates regret it!
The teacher is in a panic!
The head teacher is furious!
The main thing is not to get caught and avenge the setup!

title: Dots Master
description:
Dots Master is a fun and strategic puzzle game where you connect matching dots to solve colorful challenges. Connect dots vertically or horizontally, and form squares to clear all dots of the same color in a single move!

Each level has a special goal — clear a certain number of colored dots, pop stars, make loops, or conquer the tiles — all within a limited number of moves. With 5 exciting chapters packed with creative puzzles.

title: Animal Royal
description:
"The ultimate player versus player game allows players to engage in battles against their opponents using unique animals."
You'll be challenged to use your wits and strategy to outsmart your opponents and emerge victorious.
Animal Royal is a game that features a wide variety of animals and birds, each with its unique strengths and weaknesses.
Your goal is to protect your meat from being eaten by your opponent's animals while sending your animals to eat as much meat as possible to win the battle.

title: Cryptogram
description:
This game is for people who do not just look at letters but see the meaning behind them.
Each phrase hides a thought that can be revealed if you use logic, intuition and persistence.

title: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
description:
A classic arcade bubble shooter where you play as a devil in a trench coat, armed with a harpoon gun to tackle dangerous bouncing bubbles. Each bubble you shoot splits into smaller ones until they're completely destroyed. Navigate through levels with platforms and power-ups while avoiding contact with any bubble.

How to play:
- Clear all bubbles from each level to progress
- Avoid getting touched by bubbles - or lose a life
- Features single-player and cooperative multiplayer modes

title: Ice Cream Inc.
description:
Ice Cream Simulator is a satisfying casual game where you step into the shoes of a master ice cream artist. Your goal is to run the most popular shop in town by creating the ice cream of your dreams!

From classic Vanilla and Dark Chocolate to fruity Mango and Juicy Strawberry, you have all the ingredients needed to create the perfect frozen treat. Whether your customers want a soft-serve cone, ice cream rolls, frozen yogurt, or traditional Gelato, it’s up to you to serve them with a smile.

title: Doodle Dino Run
description: Doodle Dino Run delivers an addictive running adventure where you control a cute dinosaur, avoid dangers, and push your distance record farther every time you play. Featuring smooth side-scrolling gameplay, precise jump timing is essential to survive. Packed with action, this dinosaur adventure challenges your reflexes as the speed continuously increases.

title: Number Master Run And Merge
description: Number Master: Run And Merge is an awesome number racing game that lets you run, merge, and upgrade on a parkour platform to become a true number master! Control your number character as you run through dynamic tracks. Keep collecting more numbers and expanding. Merge with matching numbers to grow stronger. The bigger your number, the more unstoppable you become! Pick the smartest paths, hit speed zones, and keep your speed maxed out!

title: Key Quest
description: Golden Key is a challenging escape game where you must solve a series of puzzles to escape mysterious rooms. Use logic and memory to find useful items, uncover secrets, and solve clever riddles until you discover the Golden Key.

title: Magic and Wizards Mahjong
description: Enter the enchanting world of Magic & Wizards Mahjong! Match mystical tiles adorned with runes, potions, and magical artifacts across beautifully crafted layouts. Enjoy smooth gameplay with boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. Race against the clock to earn time bonuses, or use extra seconds to finish your quest. With 50 rotating layouts and stunning wizardly visuals, every match feels like a spellbinding adventure for Mahjong lovers and casual players alike.

title: Puzzle Games: Outing Day
description: Welcome to Puzzle Game: Outing Day, a casual puzzle game online. Today is the day for an outing. What will happen with all the little animals? What activities will they have on their trip to the field? Come and explore the interesting things on the camp and solve puzzles with your animal partners. See if you are the cleverest child in the crowd!

title: Cunning Ginger
description: Cunning Ginger is a super fun game that'll give you lots of excitement and intense emotions! The game follows the adventures of a cute red cat, Ginger, as he goes on a great journey around the world. He's catching falling food items and dodging all sorts of dangerous things along the way. Your goal in the game is to help Ginger explore the world and pick up as many goodies as possible. But beware - there are tons of dangerous obstacles that could harm your furry friend.

title: Cowboys Duel
description: In this fast-paced cowboy showdown, players can either compete solo or engage in a thrilling duel against a friend, testing their reflexes and quick draw skills. Will you answer the call to become the fastest and most skilled cowboy around?

title: Hero Match
description:
Hero Match: Blast, Build & Save the World!
Welcome to Hero Match! Join our fearless superhero, solve match 3 puzzles, take down the villain, and restore iconic locations across the globe!

title: Monster Slayers
description: Monster Slayers is a single‑player mobile roguelike RPG where you must survive endless waves of monsters all by yourself. Every run is a new chance to build the perfect hero, outplay growing hordes, and prove that one warrior can stand against an entire army.

title: People Playground: Ragdoll Battle
description:
Welcome to People Playground: Ragdoll Battle!
Carefully control your character to strike the right spots on your opponent’s body. Attack strategically to destroy and crush your enemies. Earn gold coins to unlock new characters and upgrade your skills.
Have fun and dominate the arena!

title: Hex Sense
description:
Guide Mochi across risky hex lands. His hex sense lets him read the numbers that give clues of how many dangers are nearby, and use them to find a safe path. Reveal tiles, flag traps, and guide brave Mochi to the Exit. 

Hex Sense is a minesweeper-style puzzle on a field of hex tiles. Some tiles hide dangerous hazards, but clues around them help you figure out where it's safe to go. Cross several unique chapters filled with new kinds of hazards and clues.

title: Pixel Blast
description: Pixel Blast is a colorful online arcade game that mixes classic gameplay with modern design. Play for free on your phone or computer and enjoy smooth controls and vibrant pixel art. It’s easy to pick up and fun for players of all ages.

title: Swat Force Vs Terrorists
description: Swat Force Vs Terrorists is an intense tactical shooter where players take on the role of elite SWAT team members engaging in high-stakes confrontations with terrorists. The game emphasizes teamwork and tactical coordination, requiring players to utilize professional counter-terrorism skills and equipment across various complex urban environments.

title: Match Dream Garden
description: What a beautiful garden! Match leaves, flowers, apples and other items to progress. Use power-ups like the Hammer to remove any piece, the Rake to clear an entire row or column, or the Gardening Gloves to swap two pieces.

title: Obby Rainbow Tower
description: Obby Rainbow Tower is a fast, winter-themed tower race where every second and every jump matters. Each floor is packed with moving platforms, icy tiles, spinning lava bars, surprise snowstorms and snowball portals that try to knock you into the void.  You can replay the tower as many times as you like, trying to beat your own best time or racing a friend side by side in 2 player mode.

title: Battle Arena
description: Fight enemies, grow your army, and dominate the battlefield! Upgrade your camp, train your soldiers and earn tons of coins to expand your unstoppable arsenal. Ready to battle?

title: Maze Escape Toilet Rush
description: What's the most urgent situation you can imagine? Of course, it is the last second of finding a toilet. In Maze Escape: Toilet Rush, you'll have a nervous and hilarious maze escape. Each level is a brand-new maze. You need to find the best route to the toilet quickly. Use your logic and intelligence to reach your destination successfully.

title: Theo Morini's Magical Resort
description:
“Theo Morini’s Magical Resort” is a magical, romantic, and captivating merge puzzle game about rebuilding a resort on an enchanted island.

Talented writers and actors created this story and brought its characters to life. Enjoy the story!

title: GT Micro Racers
description: GT Micro Racers takes high-speed racing to a whole new scale! Control tiny but powerful GT-style cars as they speed through thrilling outdoor tracks made from everyday household objects. Race across books, cans, and wooden ramps in a sunlit backyard filled with grass, flowers, and playful obstacles. Drift through sharp turns, hit insane jumps, and outmaneuver rivals to claim victory

title: Darts Master:Cartoon 3D
description: Dear dart experts and those who want to become dart experts. Please showcase your talents to the fullest on this thrilling dart journey. Collect and enrich your dart warehouse with the goal of overcoming all challenges. Experience the joy of different dart competitions.

title: Bubble classic
description: The goal of the game is not to lose as early as possible and to score as many points as possible. Improve your accuracy thanks to very competent rolling of balls. The more blocks with balls you destroy, the more points you accumulate. Check your results in the world rankings, maybe you are already number 1.

title: Supermarket Shopping For Kids
description: Have you ever dreamed of owning your own supermarket? In this casual supermarket simulator game, you can make your dream come true! In our Supermarket Shopping For Kids game, you can not only enjoy shopping but also play as a cashier and check out items! Apart from that, there are also many fun mini-games you can join in the supermarket.

title: Future War: Bot Battle in Space 3D
description: Future War: Bot Battle in Space 3D is a real-time strategy game that rewards creativity, depth of strategy, and adaptability. Victory depends on your ability to design and deploy customizable and programmable units to dominate the battlefield.

title: Sort And Style: Back To School
description: Step into the world of Sort And Style: Back To School, a fun mix of sorting and dress-up games for girls! Organize messy desks, lockers, wardrobes, and even bento boxes across 9 exciting levels. Then, challenge your creativity in the final dress-up unit where you style your school look with trendy uniforms, shoes, hairstyles, and accessories. Perfect for fans of organizing games, makeover fun, and school fashion challenges!

title: Hamstercycle
description:
Help a genius hamster bust out of a mad professor's lab on his slick DIY ride - the Hamstercycle!

Jump across furniture and whatever junk the prof left lying around to reach the portal at the end of each room. But watch out - the floor is guarded by laser sensors! Touch it, and the hamster gets caught!

Fun physics, simple controls, and hundreds of exciting levels await!

title: Hidden Object: Street Of Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Street of Secrets is an atmospheric hidden object game where you become the lead detective. A mysterious case awaits, and your insightful assistant is there to help, offering hints and guiding you to crucial details.

title: Candy Crunch: Sugar Escape
description:
Candy Crunch is a puzzle game where players move colorful block shapes to matching exits.

Each level challenges you to slide and reposition tightly packed blocks with different shapes and colors.

New obstacles appear as you progress, keeping gameplay fresh yet easy to understand. Levels are short, intuitive, and designed for quick, casual sessions.

With smooth controls and relaxing puzzles, Candy Crunch is perfect for logic and problem-solving fans.

title: Grand Mahjong Connect
description:
Grand Mahjong Connect is a relaxing yet challenging triple-match puzzle game with a fresh twist on classic mahjong.

Select tiles from the board and match three identical pieces to clear them.
Plan your moves carefully — space is limited, and every choice matters!

Enjoy beautiful tiles, smooth gameplay, and satisfying match effects as you clear the board and progress through levels.

Can you master the art of triple matching?

title: Park Me: Draw Path
description: "Park Me: Draw Path" is a casual puzzle game integrating "painting + parking + puzzle solving", which adds "drawing lines" to the traditional parking gameplay, testing the player's logical thinking, spatial imagination and path planning ability, and getting an "intellectual exercise" in a short period of time.

title: World Solitaire -Tripeaks-
description:
It is TriPeaks, one of the most famous solitaires in the world.
Take a step to go up and test your brain and luck
How far can I clean it?

title: Rotate Rings - Circle Puzzle
description: Play Rotate Rings - Circle Puzzle free online and test your skills in a clever browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Twist and align colorful rings in a satisfying logic puzzle that challenges your strategy like a true brain game. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for focused, mind-bending fun anytime.

title: Bowmasters
description: Bowmasters is a fun and action-packed game that combines creative physics with exciting Archery gameplay. Use different types of bows and weapons. Draw your weapon, judge the angle, and fire arrows to hit all enemies. The game shines with its physics-based mechanics, where timing, distance, and trajectory matter. You’ll need real skill and smart thinking to solve each shooting puzzle and land accurate hits. Every match feels different thanks to unique characters and varied weapons.

title: Mahjong connect tiles
description: Mahjong Connect Tiles is a classic tile-matching puzzle game. We have combined the authentic charm of the traditional Mahjong Solitaire with modern convenience to create the perfect game for seniors and puzzle lovers of all ages. If you are looking for a relaxing yet intellectually engaging way to spend your time, this game is designed for you.

title: Bunnies Sort
description:
Bunnies Sort is a cute and relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to organize adorable bunnies into the correct racks.

Each rack can hold three bunnies. Think carefully and move the bunnies one by one until every rack contains three matching bunnies.

With simple controls and charming visuals, Bunnies Sort is easy to learn but becomes more challenging as more bunnies appear. Can you sort them all and complete every level?

title: Labubu Pop
description:
Labubu Pop is a bright and cheerful puzzle game where the playful Labubus have completely taken over the box! Connect matching characters into chains, clear the board, and earn points to level up. Each stage brings fun surprises, and even more exciting combos!

With its colorful visuals, smooth animations, and simple yet addictive gameplay, Labubu Pop is perfect for relaxing and having fun anytime. The longer your chain — the higher your score and the flashier the effects!

title: The White Room 5
description: The White Room 5 is the fifth sequel of an adventure escape game with a cartoon art style. Find objects that can help you escape the room and use your logic to solve the puzzles. Good luck!

title: Math Master
description: Unleash your inner math whiz! Math Master turns numbers into art—solve fun math problems to unlock drawing tools, sketch colorful shapes, and bring numerical puzzles to life. Perfect for learners and creativity lovers alike!

title: Head Jump
description: run, jump, and climb to avoid direct collisions. Head Jump is a casual game, with a very fast runner forcing you to have a quick response to avoid obstacles, beautiful music will make you addicted to playing this game, difficult levels will stimulate tension and challenge adrenaline, complete each level to continue to improve your playing skills.

title: Galactic Golf Solitaire
description:
Enjoy a relaxing round of Golf Solitaire, a fun and easy-to-play card game. The goal is to clear the board by matching cards that are one rank higher or lower than the one on the discard pile. Don’t worry about suits—just focus on the numbers! If you’re stuck, you can draw from the deck to keep the game going. Play at your own pace and see how many rounds you can win.

Perfect for a quick break or to unwind at the end of the day!

title: Car Factory For Kids
description: Build and race your dream car in Car Factory For Kids! This exciting experience combines creativity, assembly, and racing into one fun-packed adventure, making it a perfect pick for young fans of car games for kids. This playful kids car game experience brings together building and racing in a fun and interactive way. Easy controls are perfect for free car game lovers.

title: Zumba Story
description: Explore every corner of the jungle, create combinations and shoot colorful marbles. With each level, face unique challenges and utilize powerful boosters to enhance your skills. Unlock exciting chapters, conquer obstacles, and experience a vibrant journey full of surprises!

title: Space Cleaner
description:
Space Cleaner is a casual space arcade game where you clear dangerous asteroid fields around your spacecraft. Use your mouse to destroy nearby asteroids, earn money, and survive as long as your fuel lasts.

When your fuel runs out, upgrade your ship’s abilities and return to space to continue cleaning the asteroid field. Destroy every asteroid to complete the stage and unlock the next challenge.

title: Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing!
description: Get ready for unbridled automotive chaos in Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing!– a game where the three elements of extreme driving merge: devastating crash tests, masterful drifting, and frantic racing!

title: Clash Crowd Game
description: Clash Crowd Game is an addictive arcade runner game where you tap to run, survive obstacles, and reach the destination. Control your crowd, avoid traps, and face thrilling challenges in every level. Easy controls, engaging gameplay, and colorful 3D graphics make this game perfect for quick fun. Run smart, grow your crowd, and prove your survival skills.

title: Gun Shooting Range
description: In this game, you are a rookie sniper at the beginning, take your rifle, pass all the missions,and grow into a professional sniper! Remember, shoot every bullet calmly, be accurate and fatal,and use the least bullets to do the biggest damage.

title: Zombie Royale Io
description: Zombie Royale io is a collecting survival arcade IO game. With 3D cartoon survivors, you need to help them rescue more survivors and shoot down as many zombies as you can. As the time goes on, you will meet more and more strong zombies. They will come and chase the last survivors randomly. You can summon more soldiers and bombs in the game. After each round, you can use the gold coins to upgrade your survivors.

title: OMG Word Sushi
description: Swipe to connect letters and form words in this sushi-themed word puzzle game. Challenge your vocabulary with over 81 levels and a minimalist cartoon style. Perfect for trivia and quiz enthusiasts. Think it's easy? Try the advanced levels!

title: Police Station
description: As the head of multiple police precincts, your mission is to boost the security rating in the district under your watchful eye. Begin your adventure by managing a modest police department, strategically hiring officers, and putting in the effort to cultivate a safer community

title: Simon Super Rabbit
description:
Simon and his friends have turned into superheroes and now they must look for the evil Professor Wolf and get their marbles back.
Grrr… That boastful and braggart Professor Wolf and his minions don’t want to give the marbles back to Simon and they have challenged him to a super mega competition which he must win to get them back. If you beat him, he will be giving the marbles back to you. Surely you can win and get them all back. Go for it!

title: My horse is amazing
description:
Ride a horse and overcome obstacles: fences, pits and water obstacles. Control the jumps — tap and release to jump accurately.

Collect powerups with powerups — increase attack and health. The further you run, the stronger your horse becomes!

Your steed is growing: it's getting faster and more powerful. Upgrade it and keep running. At the end of each level is a boss battle! Show what you are capable of!

title: Jungle Solitaire
description: Jungle Spider Solitaire is an adaptation of the classic card game Spider Solitaire with a jungle theme. It is optimized for short games and encourages strategic planning of moves with an original system of collecting diamonds.

title: Mansion Tale: Merge Secrets
description: Discover Mansion Tale: Merge Secrets, your ultimate casual puzzle adventure. Dive into exciting merge gameplay combined with home renovation challenges as you uncover mysteries and restore a grand estate.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Magic Princess Dress Up Doll
description: Welcome to Magic Princess Dress Up Doll, a casual dress-up game for girl gamers. Have you ever dreamed of becoming a beautiful princess one day? Are you an enthusiast of dressing up fashion dolls? Come join us and realize all your imaginations about fashion design! This is a fashion design game where you can make up your own doll from scratch.

title: Fun IQ Puzzle
description: Fun IQ Puzzle is a vibrant and engaging logic game that test your problem-solving skills with colorful bubble-based puzzles. In Story Mode, we have to unlock locked spaces by placing colorful puzzles in the right spots. In Time Attack Mode, we have to race against the clock to solve puzzles as quick as possible. Challenge yourself to master every stage with this fun puzzle game!

title: Plant Girl Defense Zombie
description: Plant Girl Defense Zombie is a tower-defense shooting strategy game. With 2D cartoon plant girls and zombies, you need to defeat all of the zombies in 24 levels. Change the launching track and select skills when you level up. Different from the traditional Plants VS Zombies series, you don't need to build many plants to fight against zombies. You only need to control one plant to shoot. Good luck!

title: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle
description: Party Games: Mini Shooter Battle is a battle-royale shoot-em-up game with 2D cartoon models. In 4 modes, you can shoot other players to earn scores for coins and gems. Then you can buy more roles and guns in the Shop. Your character can aim at the closest target automatically so that you only need to fire and dodge bullets from enemies. More kills and less death will make you claim more coin and gem rewards. Good luck!

title: Transformers Battle For The City
description:
In this game you will find an open world where you will defend the city from the invasion of robots. If you are a fan of transformers, then you will definitely like this game. 
In the game you will find 7 full-fledged story tasks, the complexity of which will gradually increase. After receiving the task, you will go to the place of military operations, where you can use various super-techniques to destroy powerful robot villains.

title: Gomu Goman
description: With simple tap-and-drag gameplay, Gomu Goman offers hundreds of challenging and laugh-out-loud levels. Each level is a unique puzzle that demands creativity—and a certain degree of spicy humor from you.

title: Farm Triple Match
description:
Looking for a fun tile-matching puzzle game? Try Farm Triple Match, a fresh take on tile-matching for puzzle lovers! This mahjong-inspired game is easy to learn but offers exciting challenges.
Beat levels and build your own farm with cute animals and a lovely garden.
Classic gameplay with a modern twist for relaxing brain training.
Explore a variety of tiles featuring fruits, veggies, animals, and more.
Use boosters to conquer tough puzzles and keep progressing. No time limits—play anytime!

title: Xmas Presents Mahjong
description: Match three of the same tiles. Click on a tile to move it to the collection spots at the bottom. If you have collected three of the same tiles there, they will be removed.

title: Lingo Dreams
description:
Learn English while playing
Lingo Dreams is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that helps you memorize English words through matching exercises. Find the correct pairs between your native language and English to complete each level.

Perfect for beginners, kids, or anyone who wants to expand their vocabulary while having fun.

title: Nubik Courier An Open World
description: Become a top pizza delivery expert! Race through city streets, dodge obstacles, and switch between vehicles to deliver pizzas on time. Earn money, upgrade your gear, and master exciting challenges. Fast-paced, fun, and addictive—start delivering now!

title: Home Design - Match 3
description: Enjoy a perfect blend of home design and match-3 fun! Solve colorful puzzles, create your ideal home, and activate powerful boosters. Take on rewarding challenges, collect prizes, and personalize your interiors. Play anytime, anywhere!

title: Snake Out
description: Dive into Snake Out – a vibrant puzzle adventure packed with fun and challenges! ?✨ Sharpen your skills, conquer tricky stages, and enjoy endlessly rewarding gameplay. Ideal for casual gamers and puzzle lovers alike! ?

title: Merry Christmas Stickman
description: Help Stickman escape from jail just in time for the holidays! This time, he’s on his own, relying solely on a mysterious Christmas package filled with special items. Choose carefully to aid his breakout in this festive, story-driven adventure packed with seasonal surprises—can Stickman make it to freedom before the New Year?

title: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner
description:
Become a legendary kunai master in this thrilling combination of dynamic gameplay and classic ninja action. Play offline and enjoy the freedom to dive into the adventure whenever you want. Slice through foes, overcome obstacles, and set out on an epic ninja quest without boundaries.

Will you seize the blade and claim your place as the ultimate ninja warrior?

title: Noob: parkour tricks
description:
Welcome to Noob: Parkour tricks!

This is a runner and timekiller in the minecraft universe about the adventures of Noob. Do parkour tricks and complete challenges.

Monster School kicked out Noob, and Herobrine turned him into a Gigachad!

Game Features:
- Run through the village with trials.
- Do parkour tricks.
- Complete challenges and avoid traps.
- Collect diamonds.
- Unlock new skins.

title: Slope Spooky
description: Slope Spooky is a Halloween-themed! A ball rolling down difficult and eerie slopes is controlled by the players. It's almost Halloween, which means Slope needs some scary stuff!

title: Jewel Garden Story
description: Enter a dazzling realm where sparkling jewels await your matching skills. Challenge yourself to achieve high scores and enjoy the visually stunning jewel combinations. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless entertainment.

title: Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up
description: Dress up your paper doll with mystical styles in Magical Diary: Paper Dress Up! ?✨ Get ready to enter a dreamy world where fantasy meets fashion. This isn’t just a dress-up game—it’s your magical escape, where every outfit tells a story and every style reveals a spellbound secret. Whether you're a fashion dreamer, a lover of magic, or a diary keeper at heart, this enchanted adventure is made just for you.

title: Snowflight
description: In this game, you control the flight of a bird, exploring snowy landscapes and enjoying the winter atmosphere. Various game modes await you: explore the world, search for hidden items, and take part in thrilling competitions. Each mode offers unique challenges, allowing you to test yourself in different aspects of the game and create unforgettable experiences.

title: Army Defence Dino Shoot
description: Army Defence Dino Shoot is a third-person defense idle game. It seems that a lot of dinosaurs surround you. To protect the base from incoming dinosaurs, you can summon more soldiers and engineers to create a defensive line. Don't forget to upgrade your weapons, damage, and fire rate skills. The longer you hold this position, the more dinosaurs you will meet. Have a good time building a military base.

title: Mr Long Legs
description: Get ready to wobble, stretch, and stumble with Mr. Long Legs, the funniest physics puzzle game you’ll ever play! Step into the shoes of a long-legged stickman hero and control his stretchy legs to cross impossible terrains.

title: Hexa puzzle
description:
Stretch your mind and train your brain with this addictive block puzzle game. Can you solve all of the hundreds of free puzzles?

Put your mind and brain to work to solve the puzzle game by placing the unique hexagon pieces neatly into the puzzle grid. Merge each hexo shaped piece into the grid one by one. Similar to Tetris, they all need to fit together to complete the puzzle. You may need more time to match all the blocks into the super perfect spot - but that's fine, there are no time limit!

title: Words from words: Sea
description:
An exciting game where you need to find words from the given letters and solve hidden words in crosswords.  

Welcome to the game "Words from words: Sea" - where many words and interesting crosswords are waiting for you. Make words from letters, discover new words from words, and enjoy the amazing world where words turn into magic. Join us right now and dive into the world of fillwords, creating and finding the most amazing words!  

Dive into the world of exciting levels and find all the words!

title: Italian Brainrot Clicker
description: Italian Brainrot Clicker is a hilarious one-button idle clicker that throws you into the chaotic charm of the Italian Brainrot universe. Fueled by Gen-Z meme culture and AI-generated madness, this game unleashes a world of mutant creatures and meme-fueled mayhem. From dancing cappuccinos to cactus-bodied elephants, every tap pulls you deeper into a spiral of satire and brainrot. It is weird, it is wild, and it is wonderfully addictive. You will not believe what you are unlocking next!

title: Last to leave circle Obby
description:
Last to leave circle Obby - is a dynamic online game in the style of Roblox, where only the most dexterous and persistent can win! Exciting obby challenges, dangerous traps and intense battles with other players are waiting for you. Going outside the circle means you're out, and the circle is getting smaller and smaller!

Tense obby challenges that will test your reaction and agility.
Roblox-style game with unique multiplayer.
Ability to compete with friends and players from all over the world.

title: Mermaidcore Aesthetics
description: In Mermaidcore Aesthetics, you'll embark on a thrilling undersea adventure alongside three fabulous fashionistas. Each mermaid has a unique and stunning wardrobe that will make your inner fashionista do a happy dance! With a wide selection of clothing options and accessories available at your disposal, you'll have endless possibilities to create your fashionable mermaid looks. Have a blast!

title: Bubble Merge 2048
description: Welcome to Bubble Merge 2048, where classic 2048 meets exciting bubble-blasting action! Shoot, merge, and blast through puzzles filled with colourful bubbles and challenges. Match numbers and colours, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and smash obstacles as you journey through this one-of-a-kind adventure.

title: Barry Prison Hide And Seek
description: Begin an exciting escape game in the Barry Prison: Hide And Seek! Enter an exciting and challenging prison environment. You’ll join in a nervous game of hide and seek. Enjoy the fun role-playing. As the obby or Barry. Will you play as a brave escapee, or will you be the cold-hearted guard? Begin an exciting game of “hide and seek”, successfully hide and collect seals to defeat the boss, or find all the hidden escapees to stop their plans?

title: Ship Parking Game
description: Solve colorful passenger seating puzzles on ships in this unique traffic jam puzzle game. Help passengers find their seats based on color patterns while managing the flow of people through parking lot-style challenges. It's not just about parking - you're a traffic director managing passenger jams on the high seas.

title: Words or Die
description:
Build words to survive — think fast or get crushed!

In this fast-paced word survival game, players race to create words from random letters. Each correct word builds a tower under your feet. Fail to spell on time? Lava rises, and you're out!

 - Stay above the lava
 - Show off your vocabulary skills
 - Compete against others in real-time
 - Choose your character and style
 - Only the smartest will survive!

title: Cross Connect Word
description:
Fun and relaxing crossword puzzle!

Cross Word Connect is a fun but challenging word game.
Enjoy modern word game with the combine of word search and crossword! In this fantastic crossword puzzle, you will improve your vocabulary and spelling skills.

title: Rich Choice Run
description: Rich Choice Run is a fun swipe runner where every decision shapes your final lifestyle. Slide left and right to pick the best “boyfriend” choices and grab expensive items along the way. Your choices build your value and status—choose wisely, because one bad pick can ruin your chance.

title: Obby Prison: Craft Escape
description: The game that will test your survival instincts and creativity. Will you be able to escape from prison? Survive and escape!

title: Bouncy Blob Race: Obstacle Course
description: Bouncy Blob Race: Obstacle Course is an exciting physics-based racing game. Guide a bouncy blob through challenging obstacles with just one click. The blob will move in the opposite direction of the thrust. Maneuver through the course and beat your opponent to the finish line. Grab power-ups for an extra boost and secure victory in this thrilling race!

title: Merge Town!
description: Ever wanted to be Mayor? Ever wanted to run a town, develop the land, and see a metropolis grow? Well, look no further than Merge Town!, the newest title from Gram Games. The concept of the game is simple - you have a plot of land, and it’s your job to turn it into a town. Every so often, you’ll be gifted with a house. Each house can be merged with other houses of the same variety to form a bigger home.

title: Granny's Classroom Nightmare
description: Step into the eerie halls of Granny's Classroom Nightmare, a horror survival game that blends the terrifying atmosphere of Granny Horror with the unsettling chill of an abandoned school. Trapped in an old, decaying classroom with Granny as your relentless pursuer, you must uncover hidden clues, solve twisted puzzles, and avoid her watchful gaze to escape. Each room holds a dark secret from a haunted past, and the slightest noise can summon Granny

title: NSR Street Car Racing
description:
Hit the Streets & Dominate the Race! 
Jump into heart-pounding street racing action! Customize powerful cars, master drifts, unleash nitro boosts, and challenge real players in multiplayer races and intense 1v1 duels. Become a street-racing legend!

Ready, Set, Drift!

title: Scary Pairs
description: In the new exciting online game Scary Pairs you will have fun going through the levels of an interesting puzzle that is dedicated to Halloween. In front of you on the screen you will see a playing field on which a certain number of cards will be located. They lie face down and in one move you can turn over any two cards. Look at the images on them, because after a while the cards will return to their original state and you will make your move again.

title: Merge Balls New Years Toys in 3D!
description: ● A game with a New Year's atmosphere! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a play area? where balls fall and connect if they have the same color! Connect as many balls as possible to make the biggest one, save up points?! Be the first on the leaderboard?! Play and relax ?!

title: Stunt Multiplayer Arena
description:
Go solo in a free roam challenge where you can pull off incredible stunts like front and backflips. Navigate icy and dirt tracks as you push various vehicles to their limits.

In the multiplayer derby mode, choose your vehicle—whether it's a car, truck, or van—and engage in a fierce survival derby. Compete against all other vehicles in an intense, smashing battle. 

Jump into the action today and see if you have what it takes to rule the arena!

title: Powerwash Simulator - 3D Wash
description: There’s no stain too tough, no dirt too thick that you can’t handle. So gear up, point your washer, and get ready to bring the shine back to everything around you.

title: Escape the Horror Craft
description:
Immerse yourself in a thrilling horror adventure set in the Minecraft universe. A regular, unassuming worker in Minecraft's universe becomes disoriented and has to figure out how to get out of each level and map in order to do the jobs.

A Minecraft nightmare comes to life in this eerie, ghostly realm. Stay calm as you navigate the terrain in search of an escape. Is it possible to complete each level without dying? If you're looking for a new game to play, check out kiz10.com.

title: Polygon Space
description: Polygon Space is an intense shooting challenge. Fly a laser cannon in space, battle attacking sci-fi shapes, keep firing, upgrade weapons with resources, destroy them all, and stay safe.

title: BFFs K-Pop Fangirls
description: This exciting game lets you follow the day-to-day life of two real K-pop fangirls. During the day they keep up with their professional lives, but when the clock stickers 6 PM, they gear up in fashionable combat outfits and chase their favorite K-pop idols throughout the city. Get it started, and have a blast mixing and matching different clothing items, hairstyles, and accessories to create the perfect looks for our best friends. Show off your fashion skills by dressing up your favorite girls.

title: Obby Tower
description:
Climb. Think. Survive.

Ascend a towering obstacle course filled with tricky jumps, moving platforms — and surprise math challenges! Combine your parkour skills with quick thinking to make it to the top.

Perfect for players who love obbies and want to test both reflexes and brainpower.

title: Archery Ragdoll
description: Embark on an adrenaline-pumping adventure in this action-packed online game featuring thrilling ragdoll archer physics. Master the art of archery and prove your prowess!

title: Treasure Hunt Puzzle
description: Explore ruins, complete stone tablet puzzles, and collect treasures! Solve each puzzle by fitting all your blocks into the board using the symbols as hints.

title: Beat Blader 3D
description: Immerse yourself in the ultimate rhythm experience with Beat Blader 3D, where music meets action! Slash your way through vibrant, futuristic landscapes in sync with the beat of your favorite songs. Armed with dual energy blades, you’ll slice through incoming obstacles, hitting targets in perfect harmony with the rhythm, all while dodging challenges that appear in time with the music.

title: Bus Jam
description: Welcome to the thrilling world of "Bus Jam: Clear the Bus Stop," presented by Golden Guns Studio, a color sort puzzle, fun-packed game where your task is to skillfully bus match 3d passengers onboard onto buses of the same color. Imagine a busy Bus Jam stop with vibrant buses and puzzled passengers eager to board. Your mission? Ensure each person finds their way to the right bus, and brace yourself as the color puzzle master.

title: Guess The Drawing

Aim Ninja is a fast-paced skill game that tests your timing and reflexes.

Don't forget to choose skills to increase your abilities and power. Keep calm and aim carefully.

The more participants you have, the more fun you'll have as you practice skills, react quickly, and interact with friends, relatives, and coworkers in a whole new way.

description: Join an interdimensional adventure to help a lost kitten find its way home! Solve unique challenges in each dimension. Cute, clever, and full of surprises—are you up for the challenge? Play now and test your puzzle-solving skills!

description: "Merge Squares" is an exciting puzzle game, where your task is to connect squares with same numbers. Using logic and strategic mind, you have to decide how to arrange the squares to combine them into one. Each level gets harder, how far can you go?

How far can you take your skills? The further you go, the greater the rewards!

Craft tools, mine resources, and solve clever challenges as you race to rescue scattered passengers. description:
Step into the world of retail and build the supermarket of your dreams!

Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant stack color and dynamic hoop sort challenges as you test your skills and aim for high scores. Whether you’re a casual gamer or a competitive enthusiast, hoop stack offers endless fun and engagement.

color-matching

title: Geometry Rush 4D
description: Geometry Rush 4D is an exhilarating 4D platformer that takes speed, precision, and reflexes to the next level. In this fast-paced, action-packed game, you guide a customizable character through vibrant, geometric worlds filled with intricate obstacles and dynamic traps. The game's signature dash mechanic allows players to perform rapid movements, weaving through ever-changing environments with seamless control.

title: Drop Bricks Breaker
description: Drop Bricks Breaker is an interesting casual puzzle game. You can relax yourself during play time. You only need to tap the screen to aim the bricks, then launch the ball. Isn't easy it? Come to try it now! Have a great time!

title: Find the Vampire
description: Looking for an exciting vampire game? This is a casual 3D game where you act as a hunter to put an end to the vampire uprising. Your task is to identify the bloodsuckers among us, destroy them and free the city from the threat.

title: 2048 Drop Merge
description: 2048 Drop Merge is a puzzle game that challenges players to strategically drop and merge numbered tiles to reach the elusive 2048 tile. As players progress, they must carefully plan their moves to create larger and larger tiles. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, 2048 Drop Merge is a must-play for fans of puzzle games looking for a fun and challenging experience. Have fun!

title: Popping Pets
description: In Popping Pets, stack and match adorable pets to score points! Connect three or more adjacent pets to clear them before time runs out. Look out for bombs for big clears and big points. Can you reach the highest score in one minute?

title: Backflip Master
description: Backflip Master is the most popular in sports' game. The main test of the player's mastery of backflips and skills. You need to backflip to reach the finished line. Of course, there will be some obstacles on the way, you must also flip over. So, are you ready to challenge this game now? Come on!

title: Brain Find Can You Find It
description: Brain Find brings new brain puzzles! Combine brain power and discovery for a brain challenge like no other! You can use your brain and reverse thinking to get the final target item. The unexpected way of passing levels can bring you endless laughs.  The game tests your logical thinking skills, reflexes as well as memory and creativity. Come and experience it and prove that you are the smartest!

title: Horseback Survival
description: Embark on a journey of survival in "Horseback Survival," where you, as Zohan, share an unbreakable connection with your horse, Badal. Born on the same day, your unique bond becomes a lifeline when a mysterious event leaves you in a coma. Navigate a zombie-infested world. Engage in intense combat with melee and ranged attacks, outsmart the undead by staying stealthy, and overcome obstacles with strategic running and jumping.

title: Sakura Branch
description:
The "Sakura Branch" is an interesting and beautiful puzzle game.

In the game you have pieces of a dry branch of a beautiful tree.
Turn them around and put them together.
If you combine all the pieces, life will return to the branch and it will delight you with beautiful flowers!
If you are new, you can play on a very small field on which there will be very little branches.
But if you feel strong enough, you can collect a whole tree on a huge field!

title: Steampunk Merge To Battle
description: Merge to Battle is a strategy game where the goal is to capture all the castles in your way. Unite your warriors and archers on the battlefield and fight against enemies. Build and upgrade your castle and troops. Explore the entire evolution of warriors by combining two units into an even stronger one. React quickly and use strategy and tactics to win the battle and advance to the next level.

title: Offroad Climb 4x4
description:
Welcome to "Offroad Climb 4x4", where the hills are alive with the roar of engines! This isn't just a game; it's an off-road odyssey. Imagine climbing up hills, navigating through a scrapyard of cars, scaling rocky terrains, and conquering snow-laden paths.

Whether you're a hardcore off-road enthusiast or just looking for some casual hill-climbing fun, "Offroad Climb 4x4" has something for everyone. So, buckle up, start your engines, and let the off-road adventure begin!

title: Human Leap Evolution
description: Want a wild evolution adventure from caveman to futuristic super warrior? Human Leap: Evolution is a high-energy action evolution puzzle game where every jump you make shapes your destiny. Choose wisely, evolve rapidly, and battle your enemies with unstoppable power!

title: Snake Classic
description: Snake Classic: A modern twist on the nostalgic snake game. Navigate your snake through six unique modes: Classic, Box, Tunnel, Mill, Condo, and Rail. Collect fruits and gems, customize your snake with skins, and enjoy multi-language support. Compete on personal leaderboards and play on both PC and mobile. Fun and engaging for all ages!

title: Jab Jab Boxing
description: Step into the electrifying world of competitive boxing in Jab Jab Boxing, where you'll type motivational words to unleash powerful jabs and combos, all set within a dynamic boxing ring stadium vibe. Immerse yourself in fluid character animations, draw inspiration from over 200 motivational quotes and phrases, and sharpen your typing speed as you train to become the ultimate boxing champion.

title: Epic Mine
description: In the game, you will need to correctly organize the smelting of resources in order to sell everything as profitably as possible. At the same time, it is important not to forget that resources should also be spent on skill upgrades! The game values quick reactions, but the ability to earn well will allow you to overcome any difficult spot in the game with patience and intelligence.

title: Skating Park
description: Welcome to Skating Park, where skateboards meet high-speed racing madness! Dive into a world of adrenaline-fueled stunts and fierce competition as you shred through gravity-defying tracks. Master insane ramps, outmaneuver opponents, and conquer the leaderboard. Feel the thrill as you jump off the track, taking daring shortcuts to gain the edge. Get ready to grind and glide your way to victory!

title: DON'T PANIC DUDE!
description:
Meet DUDE, a sassy AI who thinks you can't beat his game! Trapped in his chaotic simulation, your goal is simple: Jump, avoid deadly spikes, and survive to prove him wrong.

Features:

Fast-paced endless jumping action.

Unlock 40 unique and funny heroes.

Hilarious AI commentary and memes.

Increasing speed and difficulty.

Can you handle the chaos? Don't panic, just jump!

title: Last Day On Earth Survival
description: Last Day on Earth: Survival is a 2D survival simulation game. In this large ruined city, you have 51 locations to discover. When you collect some wood and metal, you can make weapons on the Workbench. When you win enough experience and level up, you can check your Attribute and upgrade HP, ATK, Speed, and Search. In the day, explore and go to places you have never visited. I hope you will survive 50 days and explore all 51 locations.

title: Cars with Guns: Wasteland Showdown
description:
Accept the challenge of the post-apocalyptic wasteland. Take on contracts, earn money and reputation, and collect valuable loot.
Survival belongs to those with the fastest ride and the biggest gun.

title: Break Beat
description: Break Beat is a fast-paced and colorful brick-breaker game with a pixel art/neon aesthetic and an electronic music soundtrack.

title: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park
description: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park is a horror escape adventure where bright amusement park rides hide lurking dangers. Players must solve puzzles, collect items, and uncover clues while evading hostile enemies. Stealth and timing are crucial—explore cautiously, hide when needed, and outsmart the threats to survive and escape. The mix of colorful setting and eerie tension creates a unique, suspenseful experience.

title: Water Sort Puzzle 3
description: Face a super satisfying liquid sorting challenge with Water Sort Puzzle 3!
